newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Volvo Q1 profit seen 5.1 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Volvo Q1 profit seen 5.1 bln SKR.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo is expected to post a pre-tax profit of 5.10 billion crowns for the first three months of 1997, a Reuters poll of 14 analysts found on Monday.
This profit would include a capital gain from the sale of its stake in drinks company Pripps worth about three billion crowns.
In the same period a year ago Volvo reported a pre-tax profit of 1.92 billion crowns.
For calendar 1997 Volvo was expected to post a profit of 11.56 billion crowns including capital gains of three billion crowns. Its pre-tax profit for 1996 was 14.20 billion crowns.
This forecast was six percent higher than estimated by analysts at the time of Volvo's last report, for full year 1996.
Forecasts for calendar 1997 and 1998 (exluding the capital gain of three billion crowns) were forecast at 8.05 billion crowns and 9.73 billion crowns respectively.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Carnegie, Den Danske Bank, Enskilda, Erik Penser FK, Fiba Nordic, Foreningsbanken, HSBC James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Swedbank, Matteus, Morgan Stanley, Myrberg & Wiklund FK, and Paribas.
